'''House Sharplyn''' is one of the known minor [[Nobility|noble]] [[House]]s of [[Andor]].

The only known member of the House is Lady [[Anthelle Sharplyn]]. She is quick to lend her support to [[Elayne Trakand]] during the [[Succession Wars#Fourth Succession War|Fourth Succession War]], and brings her armsmen to [[Caemlyn]].
